name: ergode-email-intelligence
description: Root dev-runner. Real code lives in client/, server/, pipeline/.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n client,server,pipeline -c cyan,green,magenta "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm run pipeline"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
